protocol.winner: Highest time-budget development score; then lower validation value loss; then lexical condition name
protocol.claims: Development comparisons are exploratory; final frozen-candidate superiority claims use fresh deals and report all predetermined tests without optional stopping
protocol.seed_blocks: Training seeds receive disjoint consecutive deal blocks, shared across conditions; aggregate each condition over all three seeds. Final seed selected only by validation loss.
protocol.primary_endpoint: Frozen selected model versus current structured model at 25ms; other final comparisons secondary with pointwise intervals

candidate.selection: Condition by aggregate development score, seed by common validation loss only

final.claim_policy: Primary endpoint is current structured model at 25ms; other comparisons are secondary and pointwise, not a familywise claim.
